query: SELECT p.id FROM products p WHERE p.tenant=$1 AND p.id=ANY($2) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM b2b_catalog b WHERE b.tenant=p.tenant AND b.unit_id=$3 AND (b.product_id=p.id OR b.product_id=p.parent_id OR (p.parent_id IS NULL AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM products child WHERE child.tenant=p.tenant AND child.parent_id=p.id AND child.id=b.product_id))))
